name: Patrick Slade
title: Assistant Professor
department: John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences; Bioengineering
fitReason: Strong AI-method overlap in learning personalized assistance and inferring human movement needs. His work also includes camera-based assistive navigation, so a technically bounded ML/perception project is plausible without assuming a hardware-design internship.

physicalEvidence.summary: Harvard's April 2025 Kempner report shows the current lab's wearable exoskeleton prototype, and a May 2025 institutional capstone report documents motorized ankle-exoskeleton hardware advised by Slade. A July 2026 faculty interview describes AI-driven personalization of wearable robot assistance. Historical Stanford exoskeleton results are not treated as current Harvard experiments.

shortVisit.summary: The lab contact page offers full-time summer research to current Harvard students, not external master's students. His 2025 university-hosted CV documents visitors from SUSTech, ETH, EPFL and TUM on robot optimization projects, but this precedent alone earns no current-pathway points.

name: Maria Kyrarini
title: Assistant Professor; David Packard Jr. Faculty Fellow
fitReason: Excellent fit for language-to-action systems, learning from demonstrations and human-aware mobile manipulation. The concrete collaborative-cooking and fatigue-modeling work is more directly aligned with embodied AI than rehabilitation hardware alone.

physicalEvidence.summary: A 2024 university thesis advised by Kyrarini documents an assistive mobile manipulator evaluated with 10 participants. The lab's 2026 Speech2Action journal paper extends a speech-driven collaborative-cooking line with real robot object delivery; its available preprint dates to 2023, so it is not asserted that the experiment itself occurred in 2026.

shortVisit.summary: No explicit current external master's short visit or summer internship invitation was verified on the official faculty and HMI2 pages. Local master's/capstone supervision and general lab contact are not an external summer opening.
